source: IPC-2221C (2023), Table 6-1, Electrical Conductor Spacing, as given in the source code of the pcb-toolkit crate (https://docs.rs/crate/pcb-toolkit/latest/source/src/spacing.rs)
note: The values agree with that secondary source, cell for cell. They were not compared with the standard itself. The check does not replace a safety standard such as IEC 62368-1.
